evidence_frontier: The latest frontier evidence includes successful 100‑epoch confirmations for local_width 8 (aggregate correct 444 vs control 448) and local_width 12 (aggregate correct 445 vs control 453) on ECG200 using distinct seed sets, both meeting the preregistered gate candidate_correct ≥ control_correct − 10.
analysis: Observations show that widths 8 and 12 each satisfy the relative performance gate under identical training conditions, suggesting that intermediate widths may also retain sufficient accuracy. However, no confirmation has been performed for widths between 8 and 12.
hypothesis: A model with local_width 10 will achieve aggregate Q.ANT correct count within 10 of the width‑16 control when trained for 100 epochs on ECG200, thereby passing the same preregistered gate.

proposal.title: 100‑epoch Confirmation of Local Width 10 on ECG200
proposal.research_question: Does a local_width 10 model meet the relative performance gate against the width‑16 control under the standard 100‑epoch ECG200 protocol?
proposal.rationale: Testing width 10 extends the width‑response curve and evaluates whether the robustness observed for widths 8 and 12 generalizes to an intermediate compression level, informing the trade‑off between parameter count and accuracy.

procedure: Train a candidate model with local_width 10 for 100 epochs on the ECG200 training set using each of the five seeds
Train a concurrent control model with local_width 16 for 100 epochs on the same training set using the same seeds
Evaluate both models on the ECG200 test set (100 samples) to obtain Q.ANT predictions, yielding 500 predictions per model
Aggregate the Q.ANT correct counts across the five seeds for each model
Verify that the candidate aggregate_qant_correct is at least the control aggregate_qant_correct minus 10

proposal.success_criteria: alpha5_w10.aggregate_qant_correct ≥ alpha5_w16_control.aggregate_qant_correct − 10 (candidate correct count no more than 10 below control) on the aggregated 500 test predictions.
proposal.risks: If width 10 fails the gate, it may indicate a non‑monotonic accuracy‑parameter relationship; the experiment also consumes compute budget and relies on simulation fidelity.
